individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where each point is an individual sample (n=141 samples); marginal histograms show distributions, not averages requiring point overlay.

Scatter plot type (each symbol is one cell line/reporter); scatter plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlay per the check criteria, even though points represent means of replicates with error bars shown.
Line/density plots showing distributions (normal/gamma curves); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.
Box plot; box plots are exempt from requiring individual points as they already show data distribution, and individual data points are additionally overlaid as dots.
Polar histogram displaying a distribution of phase differences (binned frequencies), analogous to a density/histogram plot rather than a mean bar chart, so individual point overlay is not applicable.
Polar histogram displaying subtype-averaged distribution of phase differences; histogram-type plot, not a mean bar chart requiring individual point overlay.
Line plot showing an example single-signal fit for illustration purposes; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.
Scatter plot (each symbol is one sample); scatter plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlay, even though error bars reflect fitting parameter uncertainty.
